searches_tried: comps.py (pipeline and work) for 'art in australia' and 'art and australia'; Gowans API searches for art and australia, art in australia, art australia journals; WebSearch general, site:armitage.bidsonline.com.au (nothing), Vol 1 No 1 dealer search. Not tried: eBay sold (blocked), Invaluable/LiveAuctioneers (need Chrome). Note the full archive 1963 to present was put online free in 2024 (SLNSW), which depresses collector demand for loose issues. Overall: no recent sold result for a 1960s-80s run; best evidence suggests tens of dollars, perhaps $30 to $80 hammer, with individual early issues worth about $10 to $40 each. | chrome: Terapeak AU sold 2 years 'art and australia magazine' (one issue type, A$8.46 each); eBay AU sold '"art and australia" 1963' (none). Too cheap and heavy to make $200 profit.
